signal.title: Beyond VLAs: How World Action Models Reshape Robot Manipulation
signal.summary: 这项研究围绕视觉—语言—动作模型展开，关注机器人如何把视觉观察和语言指令，持续转换成跨时间的动作，而不是只对当前画面做一次反应。

editorial.intro: 这项研究围绕视觉—语言—动作模型展开，关注机器人如何把视觉观察和语言指令，持续转换成跨时间的动作，而不是只对当前画面做一次反应。
editorial.why_it_matters: VLA 的记忆、推理和实时执行能力，直接决定具身智能能否从演示动作走向长时任务和真实部署。
editorial.watch_next: 继续核对实验是否覆盖真实机器人、长时任务和跨场景泛化。

evidence.excerpt: Beyond VLAs: How World Action Models Reshape Robot Manipulation | NVIDIA Technical Blog DEVELOPER Home Blog Forums Docs Downloads Training Join Technical Blog Subscribe Related Resources Robotics English 中文 Beyond VLAs: How World Action Models Reshape Robot Manipulation Aug 04, 2026 By Saeed Babamohamadi Like Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary Like Dislike World Action Models (WAMs), built on video world models instead of vision-language models (VLMs), provide robot policies with stronger physical generalization, enabling zero-shot transfer to new tasks, robots, and environments by leveraging learned dynamics rather than only semantic mappings. The open NVIDIA Cosmos 3 model, based on a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture and trained on a vast multimodal dataset including hundreds of millions of images, videos, and action samples, serves as a robust foundation for post-training WAM-based robot policies.
